    AI Overview
    Earth Day is celebrated annually on April 22. In 2026, it falls on Wednesday, April 22, with events often spanning the entire week, including major actions beginning Saturday, April 18. First held in 1970, this day marks the birth of the modern environmental movement and is dedicated to environmental protection. 
    Key Details for Earth Day 2026: 
    • Date: Wednesday, April 22, 2026.
    • Purpose: To demonstrate support for environmental protection, sustainability, and conservation.
    • Events: Activities include community cleanups, tree plantings, and educational events
      .
    • Theme: The 2026 focus emphasizes ongoing environmental progress and innovation, according to earthday.org. 
    You can find local events and actions to join through the Earth Day Event Map.

    Is April 22 always Earth Day?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Yes, Earth Day is officially celebrated on April 22 every year, a tradition that began with the first Earth Day on April 22, 1970. It serves as an annual international event for environmental advocacy, promoting sustainability and awareness. 
    Key Details About April 22nd Earth Day: 
    • Origin: It was founded by US Senator Gaylord Nelson and organized by Denis Hayes to promote environmental awareness and action.
    • The Date: April 22 was chosen because it fell between college spring breaks and final exams, allowing for maximum student participation.
    • Significance: It was chosen to echo the energy of anti-war protests, aiming to shift focus toward environmental pollution
      .
    • Global Event: While it began in the US, it is now celebrated worldwide to support environmental protection efforts. 
    While some organizations may hold events during the surrounding "Earth Week," the official, consistent date for Earth Day is April 22nd.
